searchText: Heads up msf1 is about to be nuked (in the next hour). MSF1 killed. How long do we want withdrawal-devnet-4 to be around? Looks like a few nodes are slacking behind: https://forkmon.withdrawal-devnet-4.ethpandaops.io teku/besu pair doesn't seem to be doing so well. <@341574016160497665> <@680234424037670912> . I'd suggest that we keep devnet 4 around until we're happy that zhejiang is working post-capella. If not, devnet 4 could be a place to test out patches quickly. Yeah we will have Capella on zhejiang tomorrow. Assuming it all goes smoothly, I don’t see much reason to have devnet4 still around afterwards. still working on some bad block fixes I intend to test out on devnet-4 Two nodes that haven't progress for a day: withdrawal-devnet-4-teku-besu-1 withdrawal-devnet-4-teku-nethermind-1 I’ll keep it up as long as you need Let me know if you can also experiment on zhejiang also I could, I just didn't want to disrupt it since it's public Experiment with fixes then haha i got what logs i could then bounced teku on those nodes
